description: This Java class 'WeightPackageServices' provides service methods for managing weight packages in an order shipment process, including setting package info, updating, deleting, completing packages, and saving package data within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: WeightPackageServices
classes.description: Service class providing package management operations for shipment processing within OFBiz.

methods.name: setPackageInfo
methods.description: Sets package information, validates input, and creates a new package line if conditions are met.

methods.name: updatePackedLine
methods.description: Updates details of an existing package line, including dimensions and shipment box type.

methods.name: deletePackedLine
methods.description: Deletes a specific package line based on sequence ID.

methods.name: completePackage
methods.description: Completes the packaging process, setting shipment details and calculating shipping costs.

methods.name: completeShipment
methods.description: Finalizes the shipment, marking it as complete if all conditions are met.

methods.name: savePackagesInfo
methods.description: Saves package information for an order, handling exceptions.
